summary.text: Robert Hunter is the Democratic candidate for the Alabama House of Representatives, District 28, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where he faces incumbent Republican Mack Butler.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Hunter listed a cap on annual rent increases, Medicaid expansion and a higher minimum wage as his key campaign messages.

paragraphs.text: Hunter advanced to the general election without appearing on a primary ballot, because the Democratic primary for District 28 scheduled for May 19, 2026, was canceled.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he is personally passionate about human rights, labor rights, civil rights, affordability of rent and healthcare.
He named the For the Future Victory Fund and North Alabama DSA as endorsers of his campaign.
